This is my card for **Take-home 5**. Full instructions and hints: [ROADMAP.md](https://github.com/data-science-ucsb/sports-stats-explorer/blob/main/ROADMAP.md#take-home-5-deploy-your-own-copy)

## Steps
- [ ] Sign in at [streamlit.io/cloud](https://streamlit.io/cloud) with GitHub
- [ ] Click **New app** and choose *my fork*, branch `main`, main file `app/Home.py`
- [ ] Wait for the first load (it builds the database automatically)

## Done when
I can open my dashboard on my phone.

## When I'm finished
Paste your dashboard link in a comment below, then click **Close issue**.

**Challenge (optional):** add a page that answers a question of your own, so your copy has something nobody else's does. ROADMAP.md has ideas.
